lines.text: Four characters, one costly mistake. Can you guess the meaning?
One morning, a sheep was missing. There was a hole in the pen.
Fix it, said his neighbor. He shrugged. Why bother? It's gone.
Next morning, another one was gone.
So he fixed the pen, and never lost another sheep.
It means: fix it now. It's not too late.
Did you get it right? A, B, or C?
